gautier.source: Pierre Gautier, Maître Evrard d’Orléans, sculpteur parisien du XIVe siècle, Annales de la Société d’histoire, d’archéologie et des beaux-arts de Chaumont, tome IV, 1913, pp 339–340
gautier.volume_wrapper_date: Gallica catalogues the bound 506-view volume under 1911; the article is cited as 1913 by Technè 2024 and appears under L’Excursion de 1913
gautier.review: Both printed page images visually read; article starts near bottom of 339 and ends on 340. Earlier text on 339 concerns Claude de Longwy, not Guy Baudet.
gautier.source_level: 1913 scholarly summary of a medieval act, with a short quoted residence phrase; not the act or a full primary transcription
new_details: Act reported before Châtelet notaries on 5 June 1341; notaries unnamed
Évrard’s reported residence: oultre la Porte Saint-Denis
G94 cited in 1913, preceding Ronot 1933 and Berger 2017
Earlier historians’ 120-livre price contrasted with the act’s 140 livres; one commission, not two invoices
limitations: Executors and notaries not named; no witness list
No Lirey or Charny connection established
Gautier’s hypothesized family workshop and distinction between two Évrards are historical interpretations, not new proof of genealogy or collaboration
